DESCRIPTION: A Shure Axient Digital receiver, an AD4D or AD4Q, over its command strings on TCP 2202: each channel's gain, mute, name, frequency and identify; what its pack says - battery, model, mute, lock, power; its eight transmitter slots; and its meters once a second while Rx is on. Four channels described; an AD4D has two.
